description: 鎮暴員（enforcer）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 鎮暴員

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a riot enforcer, wide and heavily armored, about six and a half heads tall: deep blue-grey heavy armor with very large shoulder pauldrons, a thick chest plate with yellow warning stripes, big forearm guards and knee armor, a closed helmet with a narrow yellow visor, black boots, heavy gloves, yellow neon lines. The hands are empty.
